premises.text: Drift moves on-screen keys under resting fingers (Home Rule) so users need not hunt for keys by feel
premises.evidence_span: Instead of making the user move their fingers to the keys, we move the keys to their fingers

premises.text: Typing is detected by combining touch and accelerometer tap/thump sensing to distinguish taps from rests
premises.evidence_span: We use two sensors, the touch sensor and the accelerometer

premises.text: Product targets the large share of people who can type without looking (any finger count), not only ten-finger typists
premises.evidence_span: 96% of people out there can type without looking. They have some form of memory typing

premises.text: Distribution via OEM keyboard licensing plus embedding the dynamic keyboard into third-party apps
premises.evidence_span: We're going to license this to OEMs directly so they can embed it in the keyboard

value.text: Much faster tablet typing that can displace notebooks for enterprise and field use
value.evidence_span: we're about 2x the performance of today's tablet solutions

causal_links.evidence_span: combine two sensors, touch and tap. That's what makes Drift and gives it some magic
get this to hundreds of millions of users
